entities.name: N-methyl difluoro nitrobenzamide
observations: Condensed substrate decodes as an N-methyl difluoro nitrobenzamide bearing an aromatic nitro group.
Exact Pd/H2/methanol reaction evidence indicates selective nitro reduction; amide and aryl fluorides remain unchanged.

entities.name: N-methyl difluoro aminobenzamide
observations: The aromatic -NO2 group is converted to -NH2; no alkene hydrogenation or C-F hydrogenolysis is evidenced.

entities.name: Pd/H2 methanol hydrogenation
observations: Hydrogen gas and palladium in methanol selectively reduce the aromatic nitro group to an aniline under the matched reaction conditions.
